shared_elements: stacked animal figures on an upright surface
justification: The strongest shared content is the use of schematic profile animals, especially a profile quadruped and bird-like/long-necked figures, carved as isolated motifs stacked vertically. The biggest difference is that B is a dense, register-like composition with many distinct signs and creatures, while A is much sparser and dominated by a single large quadruped with only a few subsidiary figures.
